settings.heading: Beauty, thoughtfully considered.
settings.description: Cosme is a modern approach to beauty — thoughtful formulas, intentional rituals, and products designed to become part of everyday life.

settings.heading: Beauty begins with intention.
settings.body:
Cosme was created around a simple idea: beauty should feel considered.

From the formulas we choose to the rituals we build around them, every detail should have a purpose. We believe effective beauty can also feel beautiful to use — quiet, tactile and effortless.
settings.secondary_text: We create products for modern rituals: uncomplicated, thoughtful and made to become part of everyday life.

settings.supporting_text: Less noise. Better rituals. Products chosen for how they work, how they feel, and how naturally they become part of your everyday.

settings.title: Thoughtful Formulas

settings.heading: Designed for the moments in between.
settings.body:
Skincare is more than a list of products. It is the small ritual that begins and ends your day.

Cosme is designed around those moments — textures, formulas and details that make a routine feel considered rather than complicated.
